stories.title: 19-year-old arrested after bullet holes, defaced gun found inside UofL student apartment
stories.summary: The police were notified after maintenance found a broken window with what appeared to be a bullet hole through it.

stories.title: Thanksgiving travel forecast: Cold, rainy weather expected in Kentucky, southern Indiana
stories.summary: A Weather Impact Alert has been issued due to impacts on Thanksgiving travel plans and outdoor events.

stories.title: Read books, win prizes: Louisville library's adult winter reading program returns Dec. 1
stories.summary: Books & Brews 502 lets adults earn points toward prizes by reading books and visiting local coffee shops and breweries.

stories.title: Farm-raised deer tests positive for Chronic Wasting Disease in this Kentucky county
stories.summary: Deer that appear sick but aren't obviously injured can be reported using an online form.

stories.title: Louisville man and woman arrested after 11-day-old infant found physically abused with drugs in her system
stories.summary: The evidence of abuse was found during a routine check-up at Norton Children's Hospital on Brownsboro Road.

stories.title: Pedestrian struck and killed on Louisville interstate Monday morning
stories.summary: I-264 East was shut down near Newburg Road for nearly three hours.

stories.title: LMPD: Man charged with murder, DUI after fatal crash on Watterson Trail
stories.summary: John Ward faces charges of murder and DUI after a crash on Watterson Trail left another driver dead late Saturday, according to Louisville Metro Police.

stories.title: Man critically injured after shooting in Shively, police say
stories.summary: Police said the shooting happened Sunday in the 4100 block of Hillview Avenue.

stories.title: Kroger's Pappy Van Winkle bourbon lottery returns Black Friday
stories.summary: The lottery gives bourbon lovers, or enthusiasts, a chance to purchase a 10 year old or older bottle of Pappy Van Winkle Bourbon.

stories.title: Southern Indiana man arrested in fatal shooting of Louisville teenager
stories.summary: Brandon Bruin Jr., 20, faces murder and firearms charges in the July 2025 shooting death of 16-year-old Airean Carr.

stories.title: Georgia man arrested after escaping custody in Adair County
stories.summary: A Georgia man has been arrested after escaping custody while being transported to the Adair County Detention Center.

stories.title: Woman killed, man seriously injured in crash on Dixie Highway
stories.summary: A 38-year-old died at the scene after a pickup truck collision near Camping Circle Friday night. The driver was airlifted to the hospital.
